title: Conflict with other laws.
bodyText: If there is a conflict with any other law, this chapter shall prevail to the extent that this chapter offers greater protection or rights to the enrollee.
bodyHtml: [§432E-2]  Conflict with other laws.  If there is a conflict with any other law, this chapter shall prevail to the extent that this chapter offers greater protection or rights to the enrollee. [L 1998, c 178, pt of §2]
